KIDS’ WALLPAPER

Green Blossom Teal Butterflies

Muted sage green washes through this dreamy garden, where soft white hydrangea clusters and leafy stems dissolve into a misty background. Teal-and-white spotted butterflies punctuate the scene, one prominent at lower-centre, with a slender lavender sprig at the right. Gentle and playful, the density is moderate but hazy, giving a calm, nursery-friendly feel. Motifs distribute evenly so scaling to different walls keeps the composition balanced, though a low headboard is best so the central butterfly stays in view. Charming for a nursery, kids' room, or serene bedroom. A continuous mural rather than a repeating tile, its soft painterly haze suits Soft Matte.
